title: Missing Numerical Values Assessment
description: Systematic evaluation of missingness mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) in numerical features to prevent estimation bias.
conditions: Column contains NaN, null, or sentinel placeholder values (-999, 9999, 'NA')
Missingness proportion is between 0.1% and 60% of total sample size
Dataset is intended for downstream parametric modeling or descriptive statistics
recommended_methods: Little's MCAR statistical test for missingness randomness
Missingness correlation matrix to identify co-occurring missing columns
Missingness indicator flag creation for MAR/MNAR tracking
selection_rules: If missingness > 60% and feature is not clinically/operationally vital, flag for removal
If missingness is MCAR and < 5%, simple mean or median imputation is acceptable
If missingness is MAR or MNAR, use iterative multivariate imputation (MICE) or flag as informative missingness
limitations: MCAR tests have high sensitivity to large sample sizes
MNAR cannot be proven statistically without external ground truth data
Dropping rows indiscriminately leads to severe selection bias
